messages:
maria: FYI I'm about to merge an on-prem auth change that switches projected SA token path and adds ONPREM_KMS_ADDR env. Need security eyes on KMS proxy egress + secret path scoping before we un-hold deploy. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/482

sam: tagging sec team. is this blocked on privacy review or just sec? we should also check vault path exposure.

alex: skimmed the diff — sidecar mounts look fine. flag: don't log token values; make sure sidecar log level defaults to info not debug.

jess-security: taking a look now. Can you paste the env list and where the projected tokens are written? Also what's the planned deploy window?

maria: deploy window target is Thu 11:00 PST (canary -> full). env snippet:

```
env:
  - name: ONPREM_KMS_ADDR
    valueFrom:
      secretKeyRef:
        name: onprem-kms-addr
        key: endpoint
volumeMounts:
  - name: projected-tokens
    mountPath: /var/run/tokens
    readOnly: true
```

tokens are written to /var/run/tokens/sa-token and rotated by the sidecar.

jess-security: ok. I see the vault secretRef in kustomize: `vault://teams/tenancy/onprem/*` — can we narrow that to `vault://teams/tenancy/onprem/redwood-inference/*`? otherwise risk broader surface.

maria: good catch — updated the PR to narrow the path and added a note in the PR description about least-privilege.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-03-19T18:00:00Z per calendar slot.

sam: infra LGTM once sec clears. also add a short smoke test that verifies tokens are unreadable by non-priv pods.

maria: added smoke test and pushed — test script is `scripts/smoke/onprem-token-check.sh` (quick run ~30s)

jess-security: I'll approve if the smoke passes and we add a log-redaction check in CI. please post CI run link.

maria: CI smoke passed: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/482/checks/7

jess-security: Approved. Left one comment to add alert for KMS latency > 200ms in the console dashboards.

sam: creating the alert now, will link in the PR.

maria: thanks — merging in 5m and will monitor canary metrics. ping me if anything odd.

jess-security: noted. monitor vault access logs for the first hour. thanks!

maria: merged and canary started :rocket:

sam: nice, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
